analyses.nonInferiorityComment: Analysis was performed for ANX007 groups pooled (ANX007 EM + EOM) versus sham.

primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: GA lesion area was assessed by fundus autofluorescence (FAF) imaging, by an independent central reading center for GA lesion area. A linear mixed effect (LME) model was used to analyze the rate of change from baseline to Month 12 GA lesion area (mm2) for all groups. The model included fixed effects of treatment, time point, treatment by time point interaction, baseline GA lesion area, baseline GA lesion area by timepoint interaction, and baseline lesion multifocality. A random intercept for participant ID and a random slope for timepoint are included to account for repeated measurements for participants. The GA lesion area was analyzed as reported (that is, not transformed).
